name: 230. Azure Microsoft-Decision-1 decisions (azure-decisions)
description: The azure provider serves Microsoft-Decision-1 natively on POST {endpoint}/providers/microsoft/v1/systemone, in Typesafe's systemone shape, with no api-version. The request model is the deployment name: the harness key aliases Microsoft-Decision-1 to the deployment Decision-1. Azure is not gated by model name, so any model is posted and a deployment that does not serve decisions comes back as Azure's own error. The model is text-only and reads an image part as JSON text with a 200, so an image is a local 400. Top-level fields are strict: an extra one forwarded with passthrough is Azure's 400. With convert_decision_to_responses on, Microsoft-Decision-1 on Azure is still served natively. Each route that reaches Azure's Decision is covered: /v1/decisions, /openai/v1/decisions and /typesafe/v1/systemone.
